stem: What is one similarity between the authors of the two essays?

options.label: F
options.text: They both wish to experience a connection with animals.

options.label: G
options.text: They both suggest that human intervention is harmful to wildlife.

options.label: H
options.text: They both think that wild animals are healthier when left in their natural habitat.

options.label: J
options.text: They both believe that animals behave most naturally when not being observed.
